rv.q: "Turret" is another example, coming hard upon, of Chicago theater at its very best. You would not want to miss the chance.
Featuring A Red Orchid ensemble members Michael Shannon, Lawrence Grimm and Travis A. Knight, 'Turret' will startle your eyes and bend your brain.
'Turret' is that rare type of show that had me saying, 'I love this' within 60 seconds of the curtain.
A Red Orchid Theatre's ambitious production, directed by the playwright at the Chopin Theatre, will blow you away.
All I can say is see this show if you can snag a ticket and get comfortable with the discomfort.
Even though it's stagnant with an overly tangled and winding nature, I recommend Turret because it's well-produced, brazen and wonderfully acted.
Still, I would recommend experiencing TURRET for yourself.
But at this point, it's just a star turn, and not a finished or satisfying one.
You do NOT want to miss this show!!
